body: I would say it's probably because your nested resource class is not static and as such doesn't have a no-args constructor. Not sure if we want to support this, I'll let the others decide :).

Does it work if the Reource class is static?

If so, I think it's enough. Otherwise, we would need to come up with some hack which I don't think is really warranted
ah I missed that since it works in resteasy - I think its fair if we don't support it but that should be a build failure then should it not ?
Yeah, I'll make it a build time error

rename.to: Non static inner class as JAX-RS Resource produces obscure error
